facts.text: The President's Guaranteed Scholarship Program guarantees scholarship award levels to entering first-time freshmen who graduate in the top half of their high school class.

sources.title: Freshman Guaranteed Scholarship - Tarleton State University
sources.quote: Tarleton State University will guarantee scholarship levels to entering first-time freshmen who graduate in the top half of their high school class and are pursuing a Bachelor's degree from Tarleton State University.
